formats.note: IMAX and 3D release in Hindi and English, on IMAX's own site and the official poster. Frame ratio is the spec's default for a big-budget Indian epic.

films.title: The Cat in the Hat
aliases: Dr. Seuss' The Cat in the Hat

formats.note: Filmed for IMAX (IMAX). About 71 of 150 minutes in IMAX's 1.90 expanded ratio, per IMAX's press release as reported. IMAX 70mm venues show 1.43, but India has none. Dolby Cinema screenings announced in the US, not yet for India. Frame ratio estimated from Villeneuve's earlier Dune films.

Rajamouli said at the launch event that it is shot entirely in IMAX 1.43. No India IMAX release is confirmed, India has no 1.43 screen yet, and one report says the 7 Apr 2027 date may move. Frame ratio for standard screens isn't announced.
